<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plugin id="Gnumeric_GnomeDB">
	<information>
		<_name>GNOME-DB</_name>
		<_description>Database UI services plugin</_description>
	</information>
	<loader type="Gnumeric_Builtin:module">
		<attribute name="module_file" value="gnomedb"/>
	</loader>
	<services>
		<service type="ui" id="gnome_db" file="ui.xml">
			<actions>
				<action name="ViewDataSources">
					<_label>Data Bases...</_label>
				</action>
			</actions>
		</service>
	</services>
</plugin>
gnomeDbSourceEvidence.makefile:
AM_CPPFLAGS = \
    -DGNOMELOCALEDIR=\""$(datadir)/locale"\" 	\
    -I$(top_srcdir)/src	-I$(top_builddir)/src	\
    $(GNUMERIC_CFLAGS)				\
    $(GDA_CFLAGS)				\
    $(GNOMEDB_CFLAGS)

gnumeric_plugin_gnomedbdir = $(gnumeric_plugindir)/gnome-db
xmldir = $(gnumeric_plugin_gnomedbdir)
gnumeric_plugin_gnomedb_LTLIBRARIES = gnomedb.la
gnomedb_la_LDFLAGS = -module $(GNUMERIC_PLUGIN_LDFLAGS)
gnomedb_la_SOURCES = plugin-gnomedb.c
gnomedb_la_LIBADD = $(GDA_LIBS) $(GNOMEDB_LIBS)

xml_in_files = plugin.xml.in
xml_DATA = $(xml_in_files:.xml.in=.xml)

@INTLTOOL_XML_RULE@

EXTRA_DIST = $(xml_in_files)
CLEANFILES = $(xml_DATA)
gnomeDbSourceEvidence.classification: Shipped UI service requires ui.xml absent from authenticated release directory/install manifest. Actual ssconvert-equivalent collector activation fails before service use. GDA/libgnomedb provisioning cannot supply an absent Gnumeric release UI definition; native source stays unpatched.
